method:
Execute original online quality preference -> rank -> storage fields.

The complete original quality owner, entitlement normalization, preference
resolution/capping, rank gates/sort/comparator and storage owner execute.
Preference/property/backend interfaces supply synthetic values. Public libc
conversion primitives, allocation and the existing standard variant-swap
provider are substituted; no proprietary quality decision is supplied.
limitations: Preference/product/backend values are supplied interface inputs, not recovered account data.
Product XML ingestion and backend-setting producers remain separate.
Stored-credential handling, account acceptance and full HTTP transport are not exercised.
